issues.title: JavaScript blind-spot wave W1 (issue #768): binding positions are definitions; write-LHS subtree suppression; call-rooted chain head
issues.notes: Surfaced by the #760 cold-pool rotation (grails-core MISSING=7, lodash MISSING=26 — the only lanes that moved off 100/0/0). The #744 bare-read walk treated every non-declaration-name identifier as a read, so import bindings, parameters, catch params, destructuring targets and export specifiers fabricated uses @0.6; the write-LHS suppression used `continue` in a stack walk that pushes children at the loop tail, so the whole statement subtree was skipped; a call-rooted chain head was emitted as raw expression TEXT (a non-symbol target). The JS-lane oracle carried the identical gate list, so lockstep mirrored all three and the lane agreed on a wrong contract — the probe battery gained `oracleForbid`, which fails as `oracle colludes`, self-tested by re-introducing the fabrication. Fixtures binding-sites-are-not-reads + write-lhs-nested-reads; mutants import-binding/binding-param/destructure-target-read-fabrication + write-lhs-subtree-skip + write-target-read-leak + chain-head-expression-fabrication; spec JSD23-JSD26.

issues.title: JavaScript/Vue blind-spot wave W2 (issue #769): a member's identity is its container, not its bare name
issues.notes: The JS method dedup key was `${owner ?? "module"}:${name}` and scopeOwnerName only reports CLASS scopes, so every object-literal member of a module shared ONE slot: the second init()/default() of a SIBLING object literal replaced the first, dead-spanning its body and dropping its calls. TypeScript kept both, so the same shape produced different graphs by file extension. Lane-visible on the real corpus: vue-element-admin MarkdownEditor/index.vue (two prop-default factories) had MISSING={toFixed,random} against the vue lane's own truth oracle, 0 after. Identity is now container-scoped (class body -> class name, object literal -> its span) while duplicates INSIDE one container still collapse last-wins. Also fixed the B5 sibling-accessor kill, which matched owner+name TEXT and so killed same-named accessors of other object literals. Fixtures javascript/sibling-object-member-identity + the re-authored vue/prop-default-factory-calls (now the real two-factory corpus shape — the #762 one-factory version passed either way); mutants javascript/sibling-object-collapse + vue/prop-default-multi-collapse; spec JSD27-JSD28. Same commit repairs 5d602664's mutant registry (ids outside the array) and adds M49.G4 script-integrity, which fails on that class.

issues.title: F5 baseline comparison is not sample-aware — cold-pool rotation makes per-lane counts incomparable
issues.notes: Probe: `bun run script/m14/differential.ts --repo svelte` at 0533251e printed DIFFERENTIAL REGRESSION for svelte:javascript (0->5 unexplained) and svelte:typescript (0->19) while the svelte lane itself stayed 100% covered / 0 unexplained. `evaluateDifferential`'s `comparable` compares only samplePerLang, never WHICH files were drawn, so the #760 cold-pool rotation (prefer never-sampled files) scores a fresh sample against a baseline recorded on a different sample. Consequences: (a) genuine new-sample findings are labelled regressions, (b) the improvement-forcing rule can never be satisfied for corpora larger than the sample without a baseline update. Fix owed: record a per-lane drawn-file-set hash in the baseline; a hash mismatch must report RESAMPLED (triage) instead of REGRESSION. Registered, NOT fixed: this entry dates the finding; the fix wave must land fixture + mutant + spec row (and the oracle mirror where the truth side is the defective one) before any status change. FIXED: sampleSetHash(relPaths) (sha256 of the sorted corpus-relative drawn set) now rides every lane row; --update-baseline pins it per lane into differential-baseline.json hashes; evaluateDifferential compares it and splits one question into three verdicts - same pinned set => strict never-grow (unchanged, still able to fail); different set => RESAMPLED <lane>, excluded from regressions, and the lane's own missing/unexplained anomalies then fail its check for TRIAGE (so a rotated lane can never pass silently on a generous pinned allowance); no pinned set (pre-G5 rows) => strict comparison KEPT plus an unpinnedLanes disclosure, so the gate is not made vacuous for the 154 unrecorded rows at once. Declared-heuristic edges do not fail a resampled lane (they are disclosed as unscored); missing/unexplained do. The claim the run makes is emitted as evidence data.baselineComparison {pinnedLanes,totalBaselineLanes,resampledLanes,unpinnedLanes}. Self-tested in the battery (audit:differential -> script/m14/verify-differential-evidence.ts, 6 cases incl. the rotated-growth case asserted to be triage and never a regression). REMAINING: the file sets are pinned only by the next canonical no-arg --update-baseline run at a stable tree (the same ceremony R2/F1-F9 wait on); until then every lane is disclosed as unpinned and keeps the strict comparison.

issues.title: JS template-substitution reads include call callees — 5 over-emitted uses edges
issues.notes: All five svelte-repo javascript-lane unexplained edges carry confidence 0.85 = the template_substitution rule (`real-javascript-analyzer.ts` ~L1881): `${escape_markdown_cell(key)}`, `${format_markdown_value(value)}`, `${escape_markdown_cell(String(id))}`, `${lines.join('\n')}` (benchmarking/utils.js), `${escape_html(value, true)}` (transform-template/template.js). The rule emits Uses for every identifier in the substitution subtree, including call callees — while the analyzer's own bare-read rule excludes callees (`!isCallee`) because the calls edge already covers them. Same defect class as M49 W1's chain-head fabrication; needs a fixture + mutant pair before the fix lands. Registered, NOT fixed: this entry dates the finding; the fix wave must land fixture + mutant + spec row (and the oracle mirror where the truth side is the defective one) before any status change. FIXED @35ce5f8b: the template walk gates on call-callee / assignment-left ancestry and owns the substitution read alone (one 0.85 isTemplateInterpolation edge; the #744 bare-read duplicate is suppressed, TS TSD28 family contract). The typescript twin carried the same over-emission and was fixed with it. Fixture javascript/template-substitution-reads; mutants javascript/template-callee-uses + javascript/template-read-duplicate CAUGHT; F3 js 55/55; F4 449/449; corpus: svelte-repo javascript lane 0 unexplained (was 5).

waves.title: F5 baseline comparison made sample-aware (G5) — a rotation can no longer mislabel a new-sample finding as a regression
waves.method: Implemented the fix owed by W4's gate flaw: `sampleSetHash` (sha256 of the sorted corpus-relative drawn set) rides every lane row; `--update-baseline` pins it per lane into differential-baseline.json `hashes`; `evaluateDifferential` compares it and returns three separate verdicts instead of one `comparable` flag. Verified at the artefact level, not from the working tree: the STAGED blob of the shared differential.ts was transpiled and asserted to carry the G5 markers and NONE of the co-agent's concurrently-edited cpp/go/zig oracle (my 10 hunks staged by hunk-scope, 137 added lines, 0 co-agent lines). The comparator is self-tested in the battery (audit:differential -> script/m14/verify-differential-evidence.ts, 6 cases: pass, regression, resampled-clean, rotated-growth-is-triage, unpinned, probe-mode) and the regression case proves the gate can still fail on a pinned sample. Deliberate asymmetries recorded rather than hidden: missing/unexplained anomalies FAIL a resampled lane's check (triage) while declared-heuristic edges are disclosed as unscored; and pre-G5 rows with no recorded file set KEEP the strict comparison plus an `unpinnedLanes` disclosure, because making 154 unrecorded rows silently non-comparable would have made the improvement-forcing gate vacuous in one step. What remains: pin the file sets in the canonical no-arg --update-baseline run at a stable tree (the same ceremony R2/F1-F9 wait on); until then every lane is disclosed as unpinned.

waves.title: Regex census anchored to committed blobs (G6); two false M12 claims corrected; R2 remainder attributed
waves.method: Chasing R2 to green surfaced a class of defect no existing gate could see: the census is derived from the WORKING TREE, so a run taken while an analyzer is uncommitted bakes an uncommitted position into a committed artifact. It had already happened - the census at HEAD recorded real-cpp-analyzer.ts:727 and real-rust-analyzer.ts:452/453 while the COMMITTED cpp/rust blobs carry those regexes at 382/405/406 - and script/m12/verify-regex-census.ts cannot catch it, because it re-scans the same dirty tree and therefore colludes with the census. Fix: the census is now derived from HEAD itself (git archive HEAD into a scratch tree, scanned there) and the census gate was re-run INSIDE that clean tree as the proof (0 stale / 0 unclassified / 0 mislocated); content change is positional only (identical (file,source,classification,operation) identity set, 20 usages, same per-file counts). New gate script/m49/verify-census-lineage.ts (G6) anchors the class with no parser and no regex of its own: every census entry must name a file present in HEAD and its recorded line in that blob must contain its recorded regex source. Passes on the regenerated census (41/0), convicts the previous one (12 anchor violations) - so it is proven able to fail - and is wired into `bun run verify` and into X1, which now refuses closure on an unanchored census. Two assertions in script/verify-m12-final-audit.ts demanding the census report ZERO usages and no needs_review class (the vacuous M12 state: census claimed 0 while the analyzers carried 55) were re-pinned to the real invariant (non-vacuous, every usage classified, needs_review within the shrink-only budget); the M12 final audit now PASSES. Deliberately NOT done: regenerating validation/m49/regex-debt-register.json, whose working-tree content is another wave's uncommitted (and already stale) edit - the required key set is recorded instead (reviews/regex-policy.md 'R2 remainder, attributed'), so nothing was overwritten.
